dedupe_keys.name: plan4res d2 4 assessing overall system costs due to massive res integration

description: The plan4res Case Study 3 report assesses the feasibility and system costs of a long-term energy-mix scenario using seasonal-storage valuation and European unit-commitment models. The native description identifies one published openENTRANCE scenario as the demonstration case. It reports assessments of storage, interconnection and thermal-generation flexibility and the cost and value of increasing variable renewable generation. This is a documented European power-system modelling application, not measured operating expenditure or a realised future energy mix. Zenodo provides the report freely under CC BY 4.0. The related public Case Study 3 dataset contains model inputs. A limitation is that the inspected metadata does not name the scenario, quantify the main cost results, enumerate model countries or state the full time horizon. No report body, dataset or numerical solution was downloaded, and the authors’ feasibility conclusions were not independently checked.
